description: Dataset for Proactive Resource Allocation in 5G Network Slicing is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mohammed jassem Al-Jumaili, Suhad Faisal Shehan Behadili (University of Baghdad College of Science). This dataset contains augmented and preprocessed network traffic and performance metrics, specifically designed to evaluate and optimize dynamic resource allocation strategies in 5G network slicing. It includes 15,760 records with key temporal and network parameters for 5G traffic. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
